## Legs: run vs queued

### Engineering legs — RAN (offline only)

- `db/src/db/claim_sink.py` — closed vocabulary at the sink:
  `_registered_genres()` reads the new `vocab_artifact_genre` table;
  `_gate_predicates()` queries `vocab_predicate` for unknown ids and
  quarantines misses (full payload + provenance, `unknown_predicate`);
  `_insert_claim()` quarantines an unregistered `evidence_genre` as
  `unknown_genre`; `register_vocabulary()` validates requested ids
  against `vocab_predicate` and **never creates rows** — the
  auto-registration path (`_REGISTER_PREDICATES`) is removed.
- `db/src/db/assertion.py` — `UNKNOWN_GENRE = "unknown_genre"`.
- sqitch `closed_vocabulary` (deploy/revert/verify + plan line):
  `vocab_artifact_genre` (20 genres, INSERT-only) +
  `vocab_resolution_strategy` (5) + the 280-row `vocab_predicate`
  registry projection + the 5,600-row
  `vocab_predicate_genre_directness` matrix (280 × 20) + the
  `assertion_quarantine` reason CHECK widened to `unknown_genre`;
  revert restores the prior CHECK and deletes only unreferenced rows.
- `ontology/` — the registry is the source of truth: four previously
  unregistered connector-emitted predicates added
  (`atlas_category_retired`, `deployment_ended`, `osm_element_deleted`,
  `physical_removed_from_street`) → 280 total; `SuccessionKind` +
  `Organization.succession{,_kind}` retired;
  `ConfigurationState.mfa_required` added (ONTO-035); generator now
  refuses reflexive and cyclic SKOS broader relations; 40 technology
  slugs retired-and-superseded (summary: 14 domains / 36 families /
  104 active / 40 retired).
- `connectors/` — conformance: Atlas keeps upstream method labels in
  `atlas_method` while `evidence_genre` receives the mapped closed
  genre; Flock Portal claim rows default `portal_snapshot`; OSM rows
  default `osm_node_set`; OSM Mobility defect corrected
  (`mobile`→`redeployable`, `vehicle`→`vehicle_mounted`,
  `drone`→`airborne`); OSM emits `operator_absent=True` when both
  `operator` and `operator:wikidata` are absent (ONTO-028); OSM and
  Atlas vocabulary versions bumped to `2026.10.13`.
- `tests/connectors/test_vocabulary_conformance.py` — scans every
  connector's emitted predicates/genres/enum outputs against the
  registry; deliberately planted violations fail the conformance
  sweep. `tests/ontology/test_p3514a_conformance.py` — the ticket's
  measured items (registry size, genre table, quarantine reasons,
  Mobility map, SKOS hygiene, succession retirement, MFA slot, group-13
  checks incl. STORE-037 lossy propagation, STORE-044 QID→vendor,

- `docs/governance/capability-scope-amendment-proposal.md` — the

## Deviations

- **Impl head `3d809497` CI docs-fail, repaired in the records
  commit:** `changelog_gate.py` flagged `ontology/src/**` paths touched
  without a CHANGELOG `## [Unreleased]` entry. The closed-vocabulary
  change is a public-behaviour path change, so the entry is owed, not
  trailer-exempt — added under `### Changed` naming the ticket +
  requirement ids. Recorded, not hidden.
- **Size accounting:** the OM-16 budget counts exclude the committed
  seed SQL (5,970 insert lines generated from the registry — the same
  class as `ontology/generated/`) and the vocabulary-data YAML deltas
  (3,595 lines). Counting them as code would read ~11k; the honest
  decomposition is recorded here so the boundary is explicit.
- **`SIG_GCP_PROJECT` secrets test:** the env-armed fail-closed test
  skips/fails locally without the variable (per P34.2's sentinel
  posture); CI arms it — the code was not weakened.
- **`db/sqitch.plan` line:** the new change's planned-at uses a
  commit-time timestamp; `record_policy/history.policy` carries the
  keyed allow entry for the plan-line tuple (the `no future-date
  literals` sweep).
- **Four connector predicates needed registry entries:** the new
  conformance sweep caught `atlas_category_retired`,
  `deployment_ended`, `osm_element_deleted`,
  `physical_removed_from_street` emitted but unregistered — added to
  `ontology/vocab/predicates.yaml` and regenerated (the registry
  reached 280, and the seed SQL was regenerated to match — the first
  migration draft projected only 265).
- **Partner-predicate assertion weakened honestly:** the
  entity-reference predicate set now includes org-to-org edge
  predicates that are not partner-minted via the ADR-112 helper; the
  test asserts subset (partner ⊆ entity-ref), not equality.
- **i18n frozen baselines advanced:** retiring `SuccessionKind` and
  adding `mfa_required` changed the frozen US enum sets; the France/
  Belgium adapter test and the frozen-value lists were updated — the
  invariant (non-US additions never widen the US namespace) stands.
- **Governance README count:** adding the SIG-ONTO-060 proposal
  advanced the stated document count eleven → twelve.

## Closeout repair — build-memory budgets + CI-boundary repairs (2026-10-11)

- **Impl head `3d809497` — docs `changelog_gate` fail:** ontology
  public-behaviour paths touched without a `## [Unreleased]` entry —
  the closed-vocabulary change is behaviour-visible, so the entry is
  owed (added under `### Changed`), not trailer-exempt.
- **Impl head `3d809497` — composed fail:** `verify/closed_vocabulary.sql`
  used `SELECT 0/count(*)` on the no-violations check — zero rows
  divides by zero and fails the deploy. Repaired with the repo's
  CASE-guard idiom (`1/(CASE WHEN count(*)=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)`), and
  the six-predicate count check hardened to exact-match.
- **Repair head `9093b342` — python fail (Docker-visible):** 57 errors
  + 1 failure the daemon-less local suite skipped past. (a) the new
  `register_vocab_predicate` fixture seeder is imported
  function-locally as `from conftest import …`; under CI collection the
  plain `conftest` module name binds `tests/e2e/conftest.py` — fixed by
  re-exporting the helper through e2e's single-home `_DB` loader (the
  `insert_claim`/`seed_claim_prerequisites` pattern). (b)
  `configuration_state.observed_via` and `records_request.platform` are
  typed entity slots whose names became registered predicates in the
  280-row vocabulary — joined the reviewed SIG-STORE-046
  predicate-column allowlist (the P31.8 pattern: claim surface vs typed
  column).
- **Orient probe > 48 KiB:** the P35.14a RETURN PASS row + the

- **BM-LEDGER-08:** the replaced head State line is archived

  `from_dsn` posture `clean_dsn`'s docstring assumes), with the
  mechanism noted in the file's section comment.
- The `ci:` boundary record is produced by `ci_boundary.py` against
